segments.ja429:1.1: Dumo yadā hoti phalūpapanno, bhuñjanti naṃ vihaṅgamā [vihagā (sī. pī.)] sampatantā;
segments.ja429:1.3: Khīṇanti ñatvāna dumaṃ phalaccaye [ñatvā dumapphalaccayena (ka.)], disodisaṃ yanti tato vihaṅgamā.
segments.ja429:2.1: Cara cārikaṃ lohitatuṇḍa māmari, kiṃ tvaṃ suva sukkhadumamhi jhāyasi;
segments.ja429:2.3: Tadiṅgha maṃ brūhi vasantasannibha, kasmā suva sukkhadumaṃ na riñcasi.
segments.ja429:3.1: Ye ve sakhīnaṃ sakhāro bhavanti, pāṇaccaye [pāṇaṃ caje (ka.), pāṇaccaye maraṇakāle ca sukhadukkhesu ca na jahantīti sambandho] dukkhasukhesu haṃsa;
segments.ja429:3.3: Khīṇaṃ akhīṇanti na taṃ jahanti, santo sataṃ dhammamanussarantā.
segments.ja429:4.1: Sohaṃ sataṃ aññatarosmi haṃsa, ñātī ca me hoti sakhā ca rukkho;
segments.ja429:4.3: Taṃ nussahe jīvikattho pahātuṃ, khīṇanti ñatvāna na hesa dhammo [na sosa (ka.), na esa (syā.)].
segments.ja429:5.1: Sādhu sakkhi kataṃ hoti, metti saṃsati santhavo [mittaṃ saṅgati sandhavo (ka.)];
segments.ja429:6.1: So te suva varaṃ dammi, pattayāna vihaṅgama;
segments.ja429:6.3: Varaṃ varassu vakkaṅga, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja429:7.1: Varañca me haṃsa bhavaṃ dadeyya, ayañca rukkho punarāyuṃ labhetha;
segments.ja429:7.3: So sākhavā phalimā saṃvirūḷho, madhutthiko tiṭṭhatu sobhamāno.
segments.ja429:8.1: Taṃ passa samma phalimaṃ uḷāraṃ, sahāva te hotu udumbarena;
segments.ja429:8.3: So sākhavā phalimā saṃvirūḷho, madhutthiko tiṭṭhatu sobhamāno.
segments.ja429:9.1: Evaṃ sakka sukhī hohi, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja429:10.1: Suvassa ca varaṃ datvā, katvāna saphalaṃ dumaṃ;
segments.ja429:10.3: Pakkāmi saha bhariyāya, devānaṃ nandanaṃ vananti.
